name: Outreach
positioning: Agentic AI platform for revenue teams / revenue orchestration: Omni conversational agent, Agent Studio, purpose-built AI agents (Meeting Prep, Deal, Revenue/Research), Kaia CI, forecasting — insight to governed action. Primary web domain is outreach.ai (outreach.io 301s there).

recent.title: 2026 Nucleo Awards nominations open
recent.summary: Oct 14 newsroom: nominations open through Nov 13 PT for six categories (Revenue Leader of the Year, Pipeline Impact, Agentic Revenue Pioneer, Rising Revenue Leader, AE of the Year, Women in Sales Leader of Impact). Nominees must work at a current Outreach customer. Prize pack includes Unleash 2027 pass and AI Credits. Marketing/community recognition, not a product launch.

recent.title: Commissioned Forrester TEI: 244% ROI for composite organization
recent.summary: Composite ($9B revenue, 6,000-person revenue org): 244% 3-yr ROI, $19.2M benefits PV, $13.6M NPV, payback <6 months. Most modeled value from workflow standardization/automation; composite in early pilots with Amplify (agentic). Also via BusinessWire. Low signal.

recent.title: LinkedIn re-amplifies Salesforce Headless / AgentExchange integration (amplify, not new)
recent.summary: Oct 3 LinkedIn post (summarized by TipRanks auto-newsdesk) re-promotes Outreach's Sep 15 AgentExchange/Headless positioning: Outreach agents and Agentforce share real-time deal context and execute multi-step workflows (update records, advance deals). Original: https://www.outreach.ai/resources/blog/salesforce-headless-outreach (Sep 15). Not a new launch.

recent.title: Deal Agent product blog: evidence-linked opportunity field updates + custom deal summaries
recent.summary: Oct 1 blog: Deal Agent reviews recorded calls/meetings (incl. historical), surfaces AI-recommended opportunity field updates with meeting title + transcript excerpt + timestamp evidence, and generates custom AI deal summaries by opportunity type. Auto-apply or accept/edit/reject; Slack + Teams; CRM sync (Salesforce, Dynamics). Cites internal 90-day usage (~90.8% acceptance among actioned recommendations). Recent innovations: append/prepend/replace, historical/field backfill, Economic Buyer/Champion auto-accept options, deal-channel Slack. Product page: https://www.outreach.ai/ai-agents/deal-agent — available today. Note: Deal Agent existed earlier (Apr 2026 release mentions); this is a major product spotlight + enhancements push, not first invent.

recent.title: GeekWire: HQ relocating to Fremont Adobe campus early 2027
recent.summary: GeekWire Sep 28: Outreach confirms HQ move from Interbay (333 Elliott) to one floor at 701 N. 34th St., Fremont Lake Union Center (Adobe-anchored), early 2027. CEO Abhijit Mitra: more face-to-face collaboration. ~800 employees. Ops/real-estate signal — not product.

recent.title: MarketScale: Outreach earns Forrester's top score on 15 of 22 revenue platform criteria
recent.summary: Third-party Sep 28 re-analysis of Outreach's Q3 2026 Forrester Wave Leader placement (company announced Sep 24); lists 15 criteria scoring 5/5 and highlights Forrester's agent-governance checklist. Secondary amplification — not a new company announcement.

recent.title: Sales Tech Edition: Analysts start doing the proof work vendors won't
recent.summary: Independent analysis (Atique Abdullah, Sep 26) on Outreach dual Leader placements from IDC (Sep 21/22) and Forrester (Sep 24). Argues dual-methodology convergence matters for RevOps shortlists; notes neither report discloses churn/NRR or audited before/after pipeline numbers.

recent.title: Named Leader in Forrester Wave™ Revenue Orchestration Platforms for B2B, Q3 2026
recent.summary: CEO Abhijit Mitra blog: Outreach named a Leader; claims highest possible score in 15 of 22 criteria including Revenue Orchestration, Forecasting, Conversation Intelligence, Innovation, Roadmap, Adoption. Forrester quote emphasizes buyer engagement, CI, and increasingly agentic workflows.

recent.title: Named Leader in IDC MarketScape Worldwide Unified Revenue Orchestration Platforms 2026
recent.summary: IDC MarketScape inaugural Unified Revenue Orchestration assessment: Outreach named Leader. CPO Nithya Lakshmanan: AI that acts, not just advises. Blog also notes Omni, Agent Studio, and MCP client/server suite shipping.

recent.title: First Revenue Orchestration Platform available for Private Offers on Salesforce AgentExchange
recent.summary: Newsroom lists Sep 15 press: Outreach becomes first revenue orchestration platform available for Private Offers on Salesforce's AgentExchange. Salesforce ecosystem distribution move.

recent.title: September 2026 product release notes (rollout through Sep 24): Omni Slack, HITL widgets, ServiceNow Marketplace plugin
recent.summary: Support release notes Sep 10–24: Omni in Slack channels, mobile Omni surveys/create-update, Human-in-the-Loop confirmation widgets before CRM writes, extracted user preferences, Sequential Dialing status, Prospect side-panel customization, Kaia buyer/seller tagging for unlicensed internals, Outreach plugin for ServiceNow Marketplace.

recent.title: Spring/April 2026 release: Omni, Agent Studio, Meeting Prep Agent GA
recent.summary: Product release: Outreach Omni (conversational agent in-app/Slack/mobile), Agent Studio visual workflows, Meeting Prep Agent GA, Deal Alerts, Deal Agent Slack updates, Knowledge base for agents, AI Topics Explorer, Smart Kaia Coach. Companion BusinessWire: rebranded primary site to outreach.ai.
